events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996 and died six days later.

angles.name: Legacy of an Icon
angles.copy: 30 years ago, the music world lost a true legend. Tupac Shakur's impact on hip-hop and beyond is still felt today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: 56 years ago, we lost a true guitar visionary. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with six strings. What's his most iconic riff for you?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road at 57
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From that legendary zebra crossing to its timeless tracks, what's your favourite moment from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the incredible Chrissie Hynde, turning 75 today! A true rock icon, what's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation, what's your favourite tune featuring his iconic vocals?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine at 51
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' album arrived. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does the title track mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod: 25 Years On
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Time to celebrate 007's enduring legacy. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the incomparable John Lennon. A true musical pioneer whose legacy lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album at 58
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, the 'White Album'. Which track from this iconic double album stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost a true legend of rock, Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul at 61
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound. What's your top pick from this classic?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon on the 46th anniversary of his death.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's his song that means the most to you?
